tutorialPages.messageText: NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "3A9DF8C94B3B9D192D2069AB4C041F7C", "Congratulations, you\'ve been elected Mayor! Mayors have access to systems and services to help manage your Settlement. You can find them in the Citizenship window.")

NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "48A4A81D4187E756BFAA118C38A1CACA", "The Treasury tab now allows you to manage citizenship dues, tax rates, and create buy orders for additional Settlement resources.")

NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "CECE1B7F46288D3FB31C628C1B71703D", "In the Buildings tab, you can now initiate new construction, upgrade, or demolish Service Buildings in the Settlement.")
NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "8DDAF6C4410BCF414959FA8B1E00FA33", "The Diplomacy tab now allows you to use War Declaration scrolls to start a War with an enemy Settlement.")

NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "BE0F6EFE4E05CB4E2D25BB9E98BD959E", "Lastly, the Mayoral Commissions tab allows you to create commissions that shape the growth and relationships of your Settlement.")
